summary: The hourly fleet admission residue count reads each replicated envelope's key from an index instead of its row, so it no longer reads every envelope's payload page from disk: about 13 GB down to about 0.2 GB a run on a 2.3-million-envelope member.

replay.detail: No replay or projection change. The count visits the same validated envelopes with the same signers, and doctor reports the same residue.

schema.detail: No schema, durable claim or projection table changes. The query uses the primary-key index replica_envelopes already has.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or graph digest rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version compatible with the previous release. Only a local read query changes, and both versions count the same residue from the same store.

downtime.detail: Activating the new binary uses the ordinary managed daemon replacement path.

manual.detail: No state repair, queue deletion or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent format changes or new rollback restrictions. A rolled-back binary reads every envelope row again.
